title: Sagittarius: try this week
old_caption: Sagittarius, this week plan a tiny trip together. It doesn't have to cross an ocean. A new coffee spot two blocks away counts. Exploring side by side is what makes it special.

title: Scorpio: the blind spot
old_caption:
Scorpio, quietly testing whether someone will stay can leave both of you anxious. The braver move is to just say it: "I need to hear you'll stay."
Ask for reassurance instead of testing for it.

title: Scorpio: what you need
old_caption: Scorpio, you need someone who can go past small talk into the deep end and not flinch. Loyalty that feels steady. Deep connection and real safety, together.

title: Scorpio: try this week
old_caption: Scorpio, you don't have to open the whole vault. This week, share one small thing, like your love of bad movies. Letting someone in a little is how trust gets started.

title: Taurus: the blind spot
old_caption:
Taurus, digging in can feel like strength, but sometimes it turns into a wall. Try saying "you might be right" once.
You can stay steady without getting stuck. A small window lets love in.

title: Taurus: what you need
old_caption:
Taurus, a flashy surprise on a random Tuesday is fun, but what you really need is someone who shows up the same way, week after week.
Consistency is a beautiful kind of romance.

title: Taurus: try this week
old_caption:
Taurus, you show love with snacks, and everyone feels it. This week, try saying it out loud once too.
Actions matter, and so do words. Your person deserves to hear both.

title: Virgo: the blind spot
old_caption: Virgo, the urge to spot what needs fixing comes from care. But the person you love isn't a project. Put the red pen down and let them be loved as they are.

title: Virgo: what you need
old_caption:
Virgo, you quietly handle a thousand little things for the people you love. You deserve someone who notices, and says thank you.
Your effort is worth appreciating. Tag the Virgo who does it all.

title: Virgo: try this week
old_caption:
Virgo, a fully planned weekend feels safe. This week, try leaving one block open, just one.
A little mess makes room for joy you couldn't schedule.
